# keychain_generic_password (Data Source)

Reads a generic password item from the macOS Keychain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read an existing generic password from the macOS Keychain
data "keychain_generic_password" "example" {
  service = "existing-service"
  account = "existing-account"
}

output "password" {
  value     = data.keychain_generic_password.example.password
  sensitive = true
}

output "label" {
  value = data.keychain_generic_password.example.label
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) The account name for the password item (kSecAttrAccount).
- `service` (String) The service name for the password item (kSecAttrService).

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the item.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for this data source (service:account).
- `label` (String) The human-readable label for the item.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password data.
